खव r. 9th cl. (खौनाति)
 1. To be past birth.
 2. To cause or procure
prosperity.
 3. To produce purity, to purify.
 4. To produce or
manifest wealth.

खवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A parasitic plant.
 E. ख, वल्ली a pedicle

खवारि n. (-रिः) Rain water, dew, vapour, &c.
 E. ख heaven, and वारि
water.

खवाष्प m. (-प्पः) Snow, hoar frost, dew.
 E. ख sky, and वाष्प vapour or tears.
